title: SG-4 -> SG-5 temporal indicator vector (flat JSON, 10 Hz)
description: STATUS: AGREED WITH SG-5 (matches SG-5's input request table; written confirmation pending). Producer: SG-4, one vector every 100 ms of SG-1 capture time. The first block uses SG-5's names, units and windows exactly; SG-5 may ignore the extras. Built only by module_4/src/sg4/sg5_output.py::to_sg5. No-data behaviour: a vector is still sent with face_valid 0, validity_score 0, counts 0, eye_closure_s 0.0. Face lost: face_valid 0 and eye_closure_s 0.0 (looking away never triggers SG-5's micro-sleep override); counts keep their window values. SG-5 fields are valid from the first frame; calibration (first 60 s) affects only perclos_vs_baseline and trend.

time_s.description: [SG-5] SG-1 capture timestamp of the latest frame, seconds, increasing.

perclos.description: [SG-5] Share of VALID time with eyes >= 80% closed (P80), 0-1 (not %). Window: last 60 s.

face_valid.description: [SG-5] 1 if the CURRENT frame has a face with confidence >= threshold, else 0.

long_blinks.description: [SG-5] Eye-closure EVENTS lasting >= 0.5 s (= microsleeps). Window: last 30 s. Counted the moment the closure reaches 0.5 s.

yawn_count.description: [SG-5] Debounced yawn EVENTS (not frames); repeats < 1 s apart merged. Window: last 60 s.

eye_closure_s.description: [SG-5] Length of the ONGOING closure, seconds, unsmoothed. 0.0 when eyes open or eye/face invalid.

nod_count.description: [extra] Nod / head-drop events (pitch <= -15 deg for >= 300 ms, or face lost right after head went down). Window: last 60 s.

validity_score.description: [extra] Share of frames with a valid eye cue. Window: last 60 s.

calibrating.description: [extra] True during the first 60 s of the drive (per-driver baseline).

blink_rate_bpm.description: [extra] Blinks (70-499 ms closures) per minute of valid time. Window: last 60 s.

mean_blink_ms.description: [extra] Mean blink duration, ms. Window: last 60 s.

slow_blinks.description: [extra] Blinks > 400 ms and < 500 ms. Window: last 60 s. (Renamed from SG-4's earlier long_blinks.)

longest_closure_s.description: [extra] Longest closure in the last 60 s, including the ongoing one, seconds.

head_down_s.description: [extra] Time with pitch <= -15 deg in the last 60 s, seconds.

face_absent_s.description: [extra] Time with no valid face in the last 60 s, seconds.

perclos_vs_baseline.description: [extra] perclos / driver's baseline PERCLOS (floor 0.02). null while calibrating.

trend.description: [extra] Slope of perclos over the last 30 s (>= +0.05/min = worsening). null while calibrating.
